name: Easyshot
subtitle: Screenshots, made simple
openItems: Publish the prepared support and privacy copy on the chosen domain.
Confirm a working support email and App Review contact email/phone.
Create or export Paraply App Store app and installer distribution identities.
Register the bundle ID and create the macOS app record in Paraply's account.
Capture and review actual Store-edition screenshots with compositor-rendered Liquid Glass.
Complete the age-rating questionnaire and any applicable account/trader declarations.
Validate a distribution-signed package when upload is authorized.
